summary: Exchange an OIDC handoff for an NPM session
description: Consumes the browser-bound handoff exactly once. Rechecks the linked local account and enabled provider. Local NPM 2FA remains required when configured.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match the configured public HTTPS origin. Sec-Fetch-Site, if sent, must be same-origin.

200.description: Ordinary NPM token or a local 2FA challenge for POST /tokens/2fa.

400.description: Exchange failed or the local account is unavailable.

401.description: Handoff missing, expired, consumed, unlinked, or invalidated by a configuration change.
